name: pancake
description: Scripts to manage FastAPI venv and run server via npm scripts (Windows)

scripts.download:ffmpeg: powershell -Command "if (-not (Test-Path ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe)) { Write-Host 'Downloading ffmpeg...'; [System.Net.WebRequest]::DefaultWebProxy = New-Object System.Net.WebProxy('http://127.0.0.1:7897'); Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip' -OutFile ffmpeg-tmp.zip; Write-Host 'Extracting...'; Expand-Archive -Path ffmpeg-tmp.zip -DestinationPath . -Force; Remove-Item ffmpeg-tmp.zip; $dir = Get-ChildItem -Directory -Name 'ffmpeg-*' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($dir) { Rename-Item $dir ffmpeg }; Write-Host 'ffmpeg ready' } else { Write-Host 'ffmpeg already exists, skip' }"
scripts.clean: rmdir /s /q .venv || echo no venv to remove && rmdir /s /q dist || echo no dist to remove
